Hi Elisa,

Thanks for the questions.

1) **Pipedrive integration** — yes, absolutely. We push all meeting data and prospect info directly into your CRM.

2) **Cost** — since it's performance-based, the exact price per qualified meeting depends on your target audience (seniority, company size, industry). I can give you a precise number after a **quick 15-min call** to understand your ICP. But to give you a rough idea, our clients typically pay between €X and €Y per booked meeting.

When would you have time for that quick call?

Best,
Andrew
